response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong web, mobile, and embedded/DLang background, but the role requires native-level Japanese, deep Linux kernel source modification experience, and specific security/networking domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, embedded firmware) none of which appear in the resume; there is also no evidence of Japanese language skills or Linux kernel work, making this a poor fit despite strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Strong low-level and systems programming background (C/C++, DLang, embedded/robotics work)
Demonstrated ability to work with performance-critical, async/networked systems (Sociomantic)
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No listed experience with required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) or switch/networking domain (L2/L3, NETCONF, SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel source modification experience
No security/embedded networking domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips)
